title: Short maintenance window for Kamailio.org
html:
There will be a short maintenance window for kamailio.org server schedule for later today, May 25, 2018, at 18:00 CEST (16:00 GMT). The website, including the wiki, as well as the mailing lists are going to be affected. We are working on extending the available resources for the server to improve speed and reliability.

The maintenance is expected to take no longer than 15 minutes.
